text:
alex: FYI I'm seeing a spike of upload failures from eval-runner when it tries to PUT per-sample KV traces to artifact-store. ~18-25% of attempts fail with 413 or connection resets this morning.
maya: ouch. did anything touch the uploader or proxy recently?
alex: no code deploys in runner. ops flipped the S3 proxy LB to v2 last night. sample errors from the runner logs: 
```
2026-03-19T08:12:04Z ERROR upload: failed to PUT /kv/trace/abcd1234: 413 Request Entity Too Large
2026-03-19T08:12:05Z WARN upload: retrying (1/3)
2026-03-19T08:12:06Z ERROR upload: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
2026-03-19T08:12:09Z ERROR upload: failed to PUT /kv/trace/abcd5678: connection reset by peer
```
jun: @alex can you paste the exact curl or binary we use so I can repro against the new LB quickly?
alex: here's a minimal reproducer we've been using locally (gzipped body):
```
curl -v -X PUT "https://artifact.redwood.internal/kv/trace/abcd1234" \\
  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \\
  --data-binary @trace.json.gz
```
maya: when we send the same gzipped payload through the old lb v1 it succeeds. through lb v2 it sometimes returns 413 then drops connection. my hunch: the new proxy either enforces a smaller max header/body size, or it touches/strips Content-Encoding which makes the backend choke. also saw a bunch of long X-RW-Meta headers in failing requests.
ops-bot: deploy:lb-proxy-upgrade v2 rolled at 2026-03-18T22:03Z by @sre
luis: also found examples where our uploader's metadata JSON is being interpolated into a single header with no length truncation: `X-RW-Meta: {"run_id":"r-123","sample_count":512, "file_path":"/tmp/eval/traces/2026-03-19/abcd"}`. if the proxy enforces a per-header size limit that could explain 413.
jun: two orthogonal issues here: 1) header size/policy on new proxy, 2) TLS reset/handshake timeouts which look like the LB is closing warm connections under load. both could produce the symptoms.
alex: runner's retry policy is backoff 3 attempts with exponential jitter. we've seen both immediate 413 and intermittent TLS handshakes. interestingly some requests that got 413 on first attempt succeed on retry (so proxy behavior might be nondeterministic).
qa-robot: CI alerted: a couple of recent eval runs flaked on artifact uploads in main->ci (failed test: `eval_runner.upload_traces_large_payload`). this started after the infra change.
maya: short-term mitigation options: 1) revert lb-proxy v2 for artifact endpoints until we patch, 2) change uploader to split traces into smaller files (e.g., 16MB chunks) and upload sequentially, 3) switch to S3 multipart uploads with presigned URLs so we avoid big single PUTs and problematic headers.
jun: agree. multipart presign is least invasive server-side (artifact store expects standard S3 semantics). but presign flow requires changes in runner auth flow and CI tokens. patch plan: add chunked write fallback path in runner and gate it with feature flag so we can flip it in prod quickly.
luis: another short-term workaround: remove large X-RW-Meta header payload and instead send a short meta id header and POST the metadata to /kv/trace/abcd/meta separately. reduces header size impact.
ops-bot: incident:artifact-uploads created (#INC-2026-0319-1) by @sre. Priority: P2.
alex: i'll open a PR to add header-size safe path + multipart fallback. will also add a test in CI that uploads a 40MB gzipped trace to the internal test artifact endpoint (so we catch regressions).
maya: Ops can we try routing artifact.* traffic to the old LB v1 for the next 2 hours while we validate the uploader patch? if we do that we should also monitor latency and 5xx rates closely.
sre: we can route a subset (10%) to v1 as a canary now. full revert needs on-call approval.
jun: note for postmortem: add a spec for max header sizes we support and document that the uploader must never place user-deterministic large JSON into a single header. also add a lint in runner that rejects meta headers > 8KB during dev.
qa-robot: ticket assigned to eng-ml/alex and eng-infra/sre. CI test added: `upload_traces_large_payload` marked flaky until fix merged.
alex: thanks — I'll push a small uploader patch (feature-flagged) and a quick revert plan for lb v2. will follow up in this thread with PR links. :thumbsup:
